name: AVA · book_appointment · realtime
description: Retell realtime custom function: book_appointment(name, email, cell, slot, business_type). Upserts contact in GHL, books next available slot on AVA Strategy Call calendar if slot empty, returns {success, appointment_id}.

assignments.name: slot
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const q = ($json.query && $json.query.slot) ? String($json.query.slot).trim() : ''; if (q && q.indexOf('{{') === -1 && q.toLowerCase() !== 'null' && q.toLowerCase() !== 'undefined') return q; return $json.body.args?.slot || $json.body.slot || ""; })() }}

assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const call = ($json.body && $json.body.call) || {}; const dig = s => ((s == null ? '' : s) + '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); const OUR = String($vars.OUR_NUMBERS || '').split(',').map(x => dig(x).slice(-10)).filter(x => x.length === 10); const dir = ((call.direction || '') + '').toLowerCase(); const isOut = dir.indexOf('out') === 0; const other = isOut ? call.to_number : call.from_number; return OUR.indexOf(dig(other).slice(-10)) !== -1; })() }}

activeVersion.name: slot accepts query param (Retell var interpolation fix)
activeVersion.description: Retell {{variable}} interpolation resolves in tool query_params but not in JSON body schema descriptions (Conductor-confirmed platform gap, 5 failed levers on test 09). Webhook slot now reads ?slot= query param with priority over body; guards against unresolved {{...}}, 'null', 'undefined', and empty strings, falling back to body.args.slot — AVA line (ISO in body) unaffected.
